# asc_group (Resource)

Manages a group in the authorization service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create an authorization group
resource "asc_group" "example" {
  name = "platform-team"
}

# Output the group details
output "group_name" {
  description = "The name of the created group"
  value       = asc_group.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the group. Must be unique within the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the group (equals the group name).
